thread:
Ana Liu: FYI i'm opening a docs PR to rename `quota_tier` to `usage_tier` across quickstarts, SDK snippets, and the tier mapping page. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 (internal)

Mark Chen: what's the rollout strategy? breaking change?

Ana Liu: not breaking. server will accept `quota_tier` as an alias for 30 days. docs will show both with a clear deprecation banner and a migration snippet. added checklist in PR.

Ruhani Singh: can you add a tiny migration snippet for the JS SDK + curl? i'll sync the SDK samples repo once merged.

Ana Liu: added both. JS example:

```
// client.js
await client.reportUsage({
  tenantId: 'acme',
  usage_tier: 'S', // new field
  units: 500
});
```

Curl example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/report \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","usage_tier":"S","units":500}'
```

Mark Chen: nice. PromQL for the dashboard? needs to include alias during transition.

Ana Liu: using regex for header/label match:

```
sum by(tenant) (increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total{tier=~"(quota_tier|usage_tier)"}[30d]))
```

Ruhani Singh: for alerts, prefer warning at 75% of committed and critical at 95%. include both avg/max variants in docs so customers can choose.

Ana Liu: added alert snippet to PR (simplified):

```
ALERT UsageApproachingCommit
IF max_over_time((sum by(tenant)(increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total[1h]))/committed_units)*100[5m]) > 95
FOR 15m
LABELS {severity="critical"}
ANNOTATIONS {summary="Tenant {{ $labels.tenant }} at critical capacity"}
```

Mark Chen: small nit: mention burst accounts get different thresholds (documented in FAQ).

Ana Liu: added FAQ note + migration playbook for support: update SDKs, update saved dashboard links, send opt-in email for early testers.

preview-bot: CI passed  docs preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/changes/612 (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

Ruhani Singh: pulled preview. two micro-nits on table formatting and an internal link to the tier mapping table; flagged in PR.

Ana Liu: fixed both and updated the curl block to be copy-paste safe. will merge after one more approval. scheduling alias removal reminder for 30 days post-merge.

alerts-bot: Reminder set to remove `quota_tier` alias 30 days after merge.

Mark Chen: approved. will sync SDK samples after merge.

Ana Liu: thanks all  merging in 5m unless objections!
